assumptions.statement: SMS OTP gateway costs 0.25 INR per message within our 15,000 INR monthly budget
Transactional Email API remains free up to 10,000 emails per day
Legacy Telecom DLT template approval does not require annual renewal
Redis session cache stays under 512 MB RAM on free tier

decisions.title: Primary Login via SMS OTP
decisions.description: Use SMS OTP as the sole user authentication mechanism

decisions.title: Stateless Zero-Cache Login Flow
decisions.description: Require fresh OTP verification on every login without persistent tokens

decisions.title: Skip Email Verification During Onboarding
decisions.description: Do not collect or verify user email addresses at signup

decisions.title: Automated DLT SMS Alert Worker
decisions.description: Send instant SMS receipts for every wallet transaction

decisions.title: SMS-Based Password & PIN Reset
decisions.description: Route all account recovery flows exclusively through SMS OTP

dependencies.rationale: Low SMS unit cost justifies SMS-first login
Relies on uninterrupted DLT SMS delivery
Cheap per-login SMS removes need for session caching
Avoids using Redis RAM for long-lived sessions
Phone number alone acts as verified identity
High-frequency SMS alerts assume 0.25 INR tariff
Transactional templates require valid DLT status
Without verified emails, recovery must use SMS
